title: Cancun vs Tulum: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Cancun and Tulum based on Reddit discussions, real costs, weather data, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 💰 Cost
categories.summary: Cancun has all-inclusive options that can be very budget-friendly. Tulum is notoriously expensive, especially beachfront.

categories.title: 🏖️ Beaches
categories.summary: Cancun has calmer, cleaner Caribbean beaches. Tulum beaches are scenic but can have seaweed (sargassum) issues.

categories.title: 🌿 Nature & Cenotes
categories.summary: Tulum has direct access to the best cenotes in Mexico and the Sian Ka'an biosphere reserve.

categories.title: 🎉 Nightlife
categories.summary: Cancun's Hotel Zone has world-famous party venues. Tulum nightlife is jungle clubs — more expensive and niche.

categories.title: 🏛️ Culture & History
categories.summary: Tulum has famous Mayan ruins overlooking the Caribbean. Cancun is a purpose-built resort city with less heritage.

categories.title: 🏨 Where to Stay
categories.summary: Cancun has massive choice across all budgets. Tulum is boutique and expensive, especially beachfront.

categories.title: 🛡️ Safety
categories.summary: Both have similar safety levels. Tourist zones are generally safe; police shake-downs can be an issue in both.

categories.title: 🚗 Getting Around
categories.summary: Cancun is easier — Hotel Zone is walkable/bus-accessible. Tulum requires a car to reach the beach from town.

categories.title: ✈️ Getting There
categories.summary: Cancun has one of Mexico's biggest international airports. Tulum now has a new airport but limited routes.

faq.question: Is Cancun or Tulum better for first-time visitors to Mexico?
faq.answer: Cancun is easier for first-timers — better infrastructure, more affordable all-inclusive options, and simpler logistics. Tulum rewards travelers who do their research and don't mind spending more for a boutique jungle vibe.

faq.question: How far is Cancun from Tulum?
faq.answer: About 130 km (80 miles) south of Cancun. The drive takes roughly 2 hours by car or colectivo (shared van). ADO buses run regularly between the two for about 250–300 pesos ($15–18 USD).

verdict: Cancun for budget, beach clubs, and easy logistics. Tulum for cenotes, ruins, and a boutique escape — if you can afford the premium.
